data.title: Thessaloniki receives 50 electric buses from Yutong
data.description: In the Greek city of Thessaloniki, 50 new e-buses have entered service. The 18-meter-long articulated buses from Chinese manufacturer Yutong are operated by OASTH, the city's public transport authority, on four routes. OASTH now has around 160 electric buses.

data.title: UltraTech to intensify supply chain electrification with 600+ eHGVs
data.description: UltraTech Cement, the world's largest cement company by sales volume and capacity outside China, has announced plans to scale its logistics fleet operation by introducing over 600 new electric trucks by December 2026.

data.title: BMW prepares Regensburg plant for the Neue Klasse
data.description: BMW is advancing its preparations for the Neue Klasse at its Regensburg plant. During a three-week production pause, the automaker installed a new pre-assembly line for the integration of high-voltage batteries, among other updates.

data.title: Zest announces ultra-fast charging Co-op partnership
data.description: In the UK, Zest is partnering with Heart of England Co-op to deliver high-powered charging at nine supermarkets in the Midlands. Zest will fund and operate the infrastructure under a multi-year agreement.

data.title: New York Port Authority launches $45m electric truck programme
data.description: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey has initiated a $45 m programme to accelerate the deployment of electric trucks and charging infrastructure. The scheme is in partnership with CALSTART.

data.title: Stellantis selling refurbished high-voltage batteries
data.description: SUSTAINera, Stellantis' circular economy business unit, is expanding its range of refurbished parts with a focus on electric and hybrid vehicles. Refurbished high-voltage batteries are now available for most BEV and PHEV models of Stellantis brands.

data.title: Vulcan advances Ludwig lithium project
data.description: Vulcan Energy has presented a pre-feasibility study for its second lithium project in the Upper Rhine Valley. The Ludwigshafen region is expected to produce 21,100 tons of lithium carbonate annually. However, several development steps are still required before an investment decision can be made.

data.title: China further reduces tax incentives for EVs
data.description: China is gradually phasing out tax incentives for electric cars and batteries. Since September, the previously announced consumption tax on lithium-ion batteries has been in effect, and further benefits will be removed in 2027.

data.title: Volkswagen supervisory board approves management’s restructuring plan
data.description: Surprisingly, the Volkswagen supervisory board has approved the management board's restructuring plan early. According to Volkswagen, the vote was unanimous - partly because a decision on potentially spinning off the core Volkswagen brand has been deferred, removing some of the immediate pressure for now.

data.title: Polestar lowers forecasts amid weak half-year figures
data.description: Polestar has reported mixed business figures for the first half of 2026. The Swedish-Chinese EV manufacturer managed to slightly increase its sales and significantly reduce its operating losses - but restructuring measures in its US operations led to additional costs.

data.title: Xiaomi builds dealer network for German market entry
data.description: Xiaomi is rapidly advancing plans for its German market launch. The Chinese conglomerate has signed agreements with eight German trade groups for the distribution and servicing of its electric cars starting in 2027.

data.title: First drive: Opel Corsa GSE delivers 207 kW for €39,900
data.description: Opel is turning Germany's best-selling small car into a fully electric hot hatch. On the test track in Pachfurth, the Opel Corsa GSE performed much more impressively than its starting price of €39,900 suggests. However, for everyday use, some features are missing, which slightly tarnish the otherwise positive overall impression.

data.title: Germany: hydrogen truck mobility ‘alliance’ moves forward
data.description: In Germany, an alliance is forming to accelerate the commercialisation of heavy H2 trucks and associated infrastructure. To achieve this, Daimler Truck, the Volvo Group, and Toyota are joining forces, supported by industry giants such as Bosch, Air Liquide, and TotalEnergies. The message: Domestic players want to establish an H2 ecosystem - before others do.

data.title: European MAN partners invest in service and charging network
data.description: MAN Truck & Bus looks set to invest significantly more in the development of its service network by 2030 than previously planned. Thanks to dealers and partners, a total of around €700m will now flow into the further expansion and development of the European service and sales network by the end of 2030.

data.title: China brand AUDI opens new Shanghai development centre
data.description: Audi and its Chinese partner SAIC have opened an innovation and technology center in Shanghai for their joint AUDI brand. Initially, four new vehicle models are to be developed there, with a focus on driving dynamics and handling, AI-powered smart cockpits, and driver assistance systems.

data.title: XD Thermal develops new battery cooling system for electric buses
data.description: XD Thermal has developed a new cooling architecture for the batteries of a European electric bus platform. The integrated system is said to require fewer components and can be adapted to different battery sizes.

data.title: Ontario International Airport secures largest-ever VALE grant
data.description: Ontario International Airport (ONT) has secured almost $4.15 million from the US Federal Aviation Administration to invest in its clean-energy infrastructure. The grant will cover 75 per cent of the cost of installing electric ground support equipment charging infrastructure at Terminals 2 and 4.

data.title: $20,300 in EV purchase incentives for California rideshare drivers
data.description: California's Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) has approved a new incentive programme offering rideshare drivers up to $20,300 towards the purchase or lease of a new zero-emission vehicle. The Drivers Assistance Program is aimed at low- and middle-income drivers working for companies like Uber, Lyft, and HopSkipDrive.

data.title: Battery health of used EVs varies significantly
data.description: While the battery health of used EVs has an undeserved reputation, an evaluation of over 500,000 battery tests by Aviloo demonstrates that the capacity loss of used traction batteries varies widely. A manufacturer-independent battery test should therefore precede any purchase decision.

data.title: Vietnam: VinFast to supply 3,000 electric cars for Green SM
data.description: Vietnamese automaker VinFast has secured an order for 3,000 EVs to homegrown transport operator Xe Nhanh Viet Nam. The latter will deploy these EVs on the Green SM platform by 2027.
